translations.web: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
translations.bsb: but some of them said, “It is by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons, that He drives out demons.”
translations.kjv: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
translations.asv: But some of them said, By Beelzebub the prince of the demons casteth he out demons.
